description.desc: As a sworn enemy of Strahd, Van Richten can be used in any Strahd Patron adventure or variant, even if he would not normally be available to be used due to variant or patron restrictions.
作为斯特拉德的死敌，范·里希顿可用于任何斯特拉德赞助者冒险或支线任务，即使通常情况下他会因支线任务或赞助者限制而无法上场。

tipText.original: Van Richten increases the damage of Champions in the column in front of him, and this buff increases in strength as undead foes are defeated.
tipText.display: 范·里希顿会提高他前方一列勇士的伤害，并且每有一名亡灵敌人被击败，这项增益都会变得更强。

description.desc: Van Richten increases the damage of Champions in the column in front of him by $amount%.
范·里希顿会使其前方一列中的勇士伤害提高 $amount%。

When a non-Undead non-Boss enemy is killed, there is a $amount% chance that Strahd will resurrect it as an Undead version of the same enemy. The enemy reappears where it died after $time second and can drop an additional quest item or count as a second kill for quest progress when killed. Does not trigger in Boss areas.
当一个非亡灵、非首领的敌人被击杀时，有 $amount% 的几率斯特拉德会将其复活为相同敌人的亡灵版本。 该敌人会在 $time 秒后重新出现在其死亡的位置，被再次击杀时会额外掉落 1 个任务物品，或在任务进度中计为第二次击杀。 此效果在首领区域不会触发。

Undead enemies are Van Richten's favored foe. When one of his favored foes is killed, Van Richten gains a Triumph stack. Slayer Training is increased by $(not_buffed amount___2)% for each Triumph stack he has, stacking multiplicatively. Triumph stacks cap at $max_stacks___2 and reset when a boss area is completed.
亡灵敌人是范·里希顿的偏好对手。 当一个偏好对手被击杀时，范·里希顿获得 1 层“凯旋”。 他每拥有 1 层“凯旋”，“屠魔者训练”的效果提升 $(not_buffed amount___2)%，以乘算方式堆叠。 “凯旋”的层数上限为 $max_stacks___2，并会在完成首领区域后重置。
Van Richten increases the effect of Slayer Training by $amount% for each Cleric, Wizard, Sorcerer, or Warlock in the formation, stacking multiplicatively.
阵型中每有一位牧师、法师、术士或邪术师，范·里希顿会使“屠魔者训练”的效果提高 $amount%，以乘算方式堆叠。

specializationDescription.original: Van Richten works with other spellcasters to defeat evil.
specializationDescription.display: 范·里希顿会与其他施法者联手击败邪恶。

description.desc: Van Richten increases the effect of Slayer Training by $amount% for each Champion in the formation with an Intelligence score of 14 or higher, stacking multiplicatively.
阵型中每有一位智力大于等于 14 的勇士，范·里希顿会使“屠魔者训练”的效果提高 $amount%，以乘算方式堆叠。

specializationDescription.original: The famous author draws upon the knowledge of others in his quest to eliminate harmful undead from the world.
specializationDescription.display: 这位知名的作家在消灭世间有害亡灵的征途中广泛借鉴了他人的知识。

description.desc: Van Richten increases the effect of Slayer Training by $amount% for each Hunter Champion and each Debuff Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Champions with both roles count twice.
阵型中每有一位猎手勇士和减益勇士，范·里希顿会使“屠魔者训练”的效果提高 $amount%，以乘算方式堆叠。 同时拥有两种角色定位的勇士计算两次。

specializationDescription.original: Rudolph associates with other hunters and individuals that know how to exploit an enemy's weakness.
specializationDescription.display: 鲁道夫会与其他猎人以及懂得利用敌人弱点的人为伍。

description.desc: If no enemies have been defeated for $time___2 seconds, Van Richten's ghost son Erasmus appears. Whenever Van Richten attacks, Erasmus quickly moves to the target he will attack and curses all enemies in a small area, causing all attacks against them to deal $(amount)% more damage. This is increased by $amount___3% for each Triumph stack Van Richten has, stacking multiplicatively. Erasmus disappears when changing areas.
若在 $time___2 秒内没有任何敌人被击败，范·里希顿的幽灵之子伊拉斯姆斯将现身。 每当范·里希顿发动攻击时，伊拉斯姆斯会迅速移动到他攻击的目标处，并诅咒一小片区域内的所有敌人，使所有针对他们的攻击伤害提高 $(amount)%。 范·里希顿每拥有 1 层“凯旋”，该效果提高 $amount___3%，以乘算方式堆叠。 切换区域时，伊拉斯姆斯会消失。

tipText.original: Van Richten's ghostly son Erasmus watches over him, and he arrives to increase damage against enemies when his father is in trouble.
tipText.display: 范·里希顿的幽魂之子伊拉斯姆斯会守护着他，当他的父亲陷入困境时，他会现身并提高对敌人的伤害。

description.desc: Van Richten raises his hand, which projects radiant light towards the enemies. All enemies take an ultimate hit, are knocked back a short distance, and slowed by 50% for 5 seconds. Enemies that are his favored foe take 400% more damage from this ultimate.
范·里希顿抬起手，向敌人投射出耀眼的光芒。 所有敌人受到一次杀招打击，被击退一小段距离，并减速 50%，持续 5 秒。 若敌人是他的偏好对手，这次杀招打击会使其承受额外 400% 的伤害。
Van Richten gains the Healing role. Every second, Van Richten heals the most damaged Champion in the formation for $amount% of his own max health.
范·里希顿获得治疗角色定位。 每秒范·里希顿会为阵型中受伤最重的勇士恢复生命值，数值为他自身最大生命值的 $amount%。

specializationDescription.original: Van Richten uses his divine gifts to heal other Champions.
specializationDescription.display: 范·里希顿运用他神赐的天赋为其他勇士疗伤。

description.desc: In non-boss areas, when Van Richten attacks one of his favored foes and does not defeat it, he Dismisses it to its home plane and he gains $stack_increase Triumph stacks. Enemies dismissed in this way do not drop gold nor count toward quest progress.
在非首领区域中，当范·里希顿攻击一个他的偏好对手但未能将其击败时，他会将其遣返至其原生位面，并获得 $stack_increase 层“凯旋”堆叠。 以这种方式被遣返的敌人不会掉落金币，也不会计入任务进度。

specializationDescription.original: Van Richten exiles his foul enemies to the shadowfell or another foul home.
specializationDescription.display: 范·里希顿将那些卑劣的敌人放逐至堕影冥界，或它们其他同样污秽的老巢。

description.desc: Van Richten casts Sanctuary on all Champions in the front column of the formation that do not have the Tanking role. Monsters prefer to attack Champions that aren't under the effect of Sanctuary first when possible.

effect_keys.override_key_desc: Enemies that attempt to choose $target as a target instead choose to attack another Champion, assuming another valid target exists.

description.desc: 范·里希顿会为阵型前排中所有不具备坦克角色定位的勇士施放“庇护所”效果。 在可能的情况下，怪物会优先攻击未受“庇护所”效果影响的勇士。

effect_keys.override_key_desc: 试图将$target选为目标的敌人会改为攻击另一位勇士，前提是存在其他有效目标。

specializationDescription.original: Van Richten protects his allies from attack.
specializationDescription.display: 范·里希顿保护他的盟友免受攻击。

description.original: I do what I must for the greater good, no matter the pain I must suffer.
description.display: 为了大家的利益，无论要承受怎样的痛苦，我都会去做我必须做的事。

description.original: Many have followed in my legacy. They are all Van Richtens in my eyes.
description.display: 许多人都继承了我的衣钵。 在我眼里，他们都是范·里希顿。

description.original: If you choose to walk this path, you will know no peace. However...
description.display: 如果你选择走上这条路，就别想再有安宁。 不过……

description.original: The strife you must endure bestows peace to innocent lives.
description.display: 你必须承受的苦难，会为无辜之人带来安宁。

description.original: What a terrible night to have a curse.
description.display: 在这样的夜晚遭受诅咒可不妙啊。

description.original: Such victories are short-lived, but they do provide motivation.
description.display: 这样的胜利转瞬即逝，但确实能让人更有干劲。

description.original: The corruption will leave an area for a time, if one excises enough of it.
description.display: 只要清除掉足够多的腐化，某个区域的腐化之力就会暂时退散。

description.original: Sometimes I feel as if my dear son is still with me, somehow.
description.display: 有时候我觉得，我的宝贝儿子还在以某种方式陪在我身边。

description.original: Were it possible, I would tell him that I love him, and cherish his memory.
description.display: 如果可以的话，我真想告诉他我爱他，并会珍藏他留给我的回忆。

description.original: Every foe felled ensures that my son's death was not in vain.
description.display: 每击倒一个敌人，都能证明我儿子没有白白牺牲。

description.original: Newly risen? Then you must not yet know who I am. Time for a brief introduction.
description.display: 刚刚苏醒？ 那你肯定还不知道我是谁。 是时候简单介绍一下我自己了。

effects.description: Increases the effect of Van Richten's first set of Specializations by $(amount)%

description.original: You do not frighten me, monster. On the contrary, you should be afraid.
description.display: 怪物，你吓不着我。 相反，该害怕的是你。

effects.description: Increases the effect of Van Richten's first set of Specializations by $(amount)%

description.original: My true foe has many names. 'The Devil,' for one. Well, even devils may die.
description.display: 我真正的仇敌有很多名称。 比如说，“魔鬼”。 哼，哪怕魔鬼也是会死的。

effects.description: Add Fiend as a favored foe for Van Richten.

description.original: I'm no spring chicken, but I do maintain a regimen of calisthenics.
description.display: 我已经不年轻了，但我一直在坚持做自重训练。

description.original: I have faith that my students will carry on my work long after I am gone.
description.display: 我相信即使在我离开很久后，我的学生们也会继续我的事业。

description.original: The balance is off. The grip is wrong. Bah! I cannot work with this!
description.display: 平衡不行，握感也不对。 呸！ 这玩意儿我没法用！

description.original: Only a short-lived fool believes an old man incapable of defending himself.
description.display: 只有短命的蠢货才会以为老头子没办法保护自己。

description.original: An elegant weapon, for inelegant foes.
description.display: 优雅的武器，专治不优雅的敌人。

description.original: The worst monsters deserve the most agonizing ends. I insist.
description.display: 最邪恶的怪物，就该迎来最痛苦的结局。 我坚持这一点。

description.original: Where did I leave that blasted thing? And in what form? Hm...
description.display: 我把那该死的玩意儿放哪儿了？ 它是什么形态来着？ 唔……

description.original: You may have met me once or twice, but not as I appear before you now.
description.display: 你也许见过我一两次，但绝不是我现在这副模样。

description.original: Let them assume they have power over me. Let them assume they are safe.
description.display: 就让他们以为自己能拿捏我。 就让他们以为自己很安全。

description.original: Each quarrel carries searing radiance to burn away evil.
description.display: 每支弩矢都带着灼热的圣光，可焚灭邪恶。

description.original: I should restock soon, and check in on the twins and Beatrice.
description.display: 我得尽快补给一下，顺便去看看那对双胞胎和比阿特丽斯。

description.original: Natural remedies for supernatural problems.
description.display: 解决超自然问题的自然疗法。

description.original: I've studied the affliction. There is only one cure.
description.display: 我研究过这种病症。 只有一种治法。

description.original: Holy water and spell scrolls. No matter what awaits me, I am always prepared.
description.display: 圣水和法术卷轴。 不管前方有什么在等着我，我都时刻做好准备。

description.original: Years of monster hunting have not been kind to it. I should clean this.
description.display: 多年猎魔岁月的洗礼让它变得黯淡无光。 我得把它擦干净。

description.original: I must do all I can to prevent further tragedy. Ingrid, Erasmus, forgive me...
description.display: 我必须竭尽所能阻止更多悲剧发生。 英格丽德，伊拉斯姆斯，原谅我……

description.original: My title was earned, I assure you. Now tell me your ailment and be quick.
description.display: 我向你保证，我的头衔是我凭本事挣来的。 现在，快说说你哪里不舒服。

description.original: It glows ever more brightly when sorrow shrouds my heart.
description.display: 当悲伤笼罩我心时，它会愈发明亮地发光。

description.original: This one comes and goes as it pleases. Where are you off to this time?
description.display: 这家伙想来就来，想走就走。 这次你又要跑哪儿去？

effects.description: Increases the effect of Van Richten's first set of Specializations by $(amount)%

description.original: This mischievous scamp delights the children. Innkeepers, less so.
description.display: 这小捣蛋鬼把孩子们逗得很开心。 不过，旅店老板可不怎么开心。

effects.description: Increases the effect of Van Richten's first set of Specializations by $(amount)%

description.original: Despite what you may have heard, her diet of apples does not deter me.
description.display: 不管你听说过什么，她天天吃苹果可赶不走我。

effects.description: Increases the effect of Van Richten's first set of Specializations by $(amount)%

description.original: This one is well-trained. Harmless to the living. A ruinous force to the dead.
description.display: 这家伙训练有素。 对活人无害。 对亡者却能造成毁灭性的打击。

effects.description: Increases the effect of Van Richten's first set of Specializations by $(amount)%

description.original: I present cold and bare facts to arm my readers. Unlike a certain hack.
description.display: 我会呈现冰冷且赤裸裸的事实，让我的读者有所准备。 不像某个三流写手。

description.original: Not all lycanthropes are evil, mind you. However, all are dangerous.
description.display: 注意，并非所有兽化人都是邪恶的。 但它们全都很危险。

name.display: 范·里希顿的吸血鬼指南

description.original: I taught Ezmerelda - Pardon me. I taught Ez everything I know.
description.display: 我向艾丝美拉达——抱歉， 我向艾茨传授了我所知道的一切。

name.display: 范·里希顿的鸦阁魔域指南

description.original: I am the foremost expert on the subject matter. It is not a boast. It is fact.
description.display: 在这方面，我就是最权威的专家。 这可不是我自夸。 这是事实。

effects.description: Increases the damage of all Champions by $amount%
Increases the damage of all Champions by $(amount)% for each Male Champion in the formation
Increases the damage of all Champions by $(amount)% for each Human Champion in the formation
Increases the damage of all Champions with a INT score of 13 or higher by $(amount)%
Increases the damage of all Lawful Champions by $(amount)%
Increases the damage of all Champions by $(amount)% for each Melee Champion in the formation

backstory.original: Once a mere doctor from the dread domain of Darkon, Rudolph van Richten was forced down a haunted and tragic path of revenge after losing his wife and son to the cruelty of monsters. Now, as a legendary vampire hunter, he stands undaunted against the evils that dwell within the mists. Van Richten has trained a myriad of successors to his legacy throughout the years, including fellow Champion, Ez.
backstory.display: 鲁道夫·范·里希顿原本只是达孔恐惧领域的一名医生，在妻儿惨遭怪物残害后，他被迫踏上了一条鬼影重重的悲惨复仇之路。 如今，身为传奇吸血鬼猎手的他无畏地对抗着潜伏在迷雾之中的邪恶。 这些年来，范·里希顿培养了无数继承自己衣钵的后继者，其中包括同为勇士的艾茨。

description.original: Van Richten slashes the nearest enemy with his Silver Sword Cane.
description.display: 范·里希顿会用白银剑杖斩击最近的敌人。

longDescription.original: Van Richten leaps out and slashes the nearest enemy with his Silver Sword Cane, dealing one hit. Deals an additional 5 seconds of BUD-based damage to Van Richten's Favored Foes.
longDescription.display: 范·里希顿飞身跃出，用白银剑杖斩击最近的敌人，造成 1 次打击。 对范·里希顿的偏好敌人额外造成持续 5 秒的基础杀招伤害。

description.original: Van Richten repels all foes a short distance, dealing 1 ultimate hit and slowing them.
description.display: 范·里希顿将所有敌人击退一小段距离，造成 1 次杀招打击并使他们减速。

longDescription.original: Van Richten repels all foes a short distance, dealing 1 ultimate hit and slowing them. Damage is greater against his favored foes.
longDescription.display: 范·里希顿将所有敌人击退一小段距离，造成 1 次杀招打击并使他们减速。 对其偏好敌人造成的伤害更高。

character_sheet_details.backstory: Once a mere doctor from the dread domain of Darkon, Rudolph van Richten was forced down a haunted and tragic path of revenge after losing his wife and son to the cruelty of monsters. Now, as a legendary vampire hunter, he stands undaunted against the evils that dwell within the mists. Van Richten has trained a myriad of successors to his legacy throughout the years, including fellow Champion, Ez.
character_sheet_details.system_description: Rudolph Van Richten is a Support, Hunter, and Debuff Champion who has dedicated his life to fighting evil, especially the undead. Van Richten supports Champions in the column in front of him, and this support increases as more undead are defeated. Undead foes are often encountered, as his greatest enemy Strahd summons them to get in his way.

character_sheet_details.backstory: 鲁道夫·范·里希顿原本只是达孔恐惧领域的一名医生，在妻儿惨遭怪物残害后，他被迫踏上了一条鬼影重重的悲惨复仇之路。 如今，身为传奇吸血鬼猎手的他无畏地对抗着潜伏在迷雾之中的邪恶。 这些年来，范·里希顿培养了无数继承自己衣钵的后继者，其中包括同为勇士的艾茨。
character_sheet_details.system_description: 鲁道夫·范·里希顿是一位兼具支援、猎手与减益角色定位的勇士，一生致力于对抗邪恶，尤其是亡灵。 范·里希顿会支援位于他前方一列的勇士，且随着击败的亡灵越多，他的支援效果越强。 你会经常遭遇亡灵敌人，因为他最大的宿敌斯特拉德会召唤它们来阻挡他前进的道路。

display.specialization_description: 范·里希顿将那些卑劣的敌人放逐至堕影冥界，或它们其他同样污秽的老巢。

original.name: Occult Aid: Sanctuary
original.specialization_description: Van Richten protects his allies from attack.

display.name: 秘法援助：庇护所
display.specialization_description: 范·里希顿保护他的盟友免受攻击。

original.name: Selflessness
original.description: I do what I must for the greater good, no matter the pain I must suffer.

display.name: 无私
display.description: 为了大家的利益，无论要承受怎样的痛苦，我都会去做我必须做的事。

original.name: Inspiring Leader
original.description: Many have followed in my legacy. They are all Van Richtens in my eyes.

display.name: 鼓舞人心的首领
display.description: 许多人都继承了我的衣钵。 在我眼里，他们都是范·里希顿。

original.name: Neophyte Slayer
original.description: If you choose to walk this path, you will know no peace. However...

display.name: 新手屠魔者
display.description: 如果你选择走上这条路，就别想再有安宁。 不过……

original.name: Journeyman Slayer
original.description: The strife you must endure bestows peace to innocent lives.

display.name: 熟练屠魔者
display.description: 你必须承受的苦难，会为无辜之人带来安宁。

original.name: Always Among Monsters
original.description: What a terrible night to have a curse.

display.name: 怪物常伴
display.description: 在这样的夜晚遭受诅咒可不妙啊。

original.name: Momentary Triumph
original.description: Such victories are short-lived, but they do provide motivation.

display.name: 短暂的胜利
display.description: 这样的胜利转瞬即逝，但确实能让人更有干劲。

original.name: Resounding Triumph
original.description: The corruption will leave an area for a time, if one excises enough of it.

display.name: 彻底的胜利
display.description: 只要清除掉足够多的腐化，某个区域的腐化之力就会暂时退散。

original.name: Watchful Spirit
original.description: Sometimes I feel as if my dear son is still with me, somehow.

display.name: 守望之灵
display.description: 有时候我觉得，我的宝贝儿子还在以某种方式陪在我身边。

original.name: Vigilant Spirit
original.description: Were it possible, I would tell him that I love him, and cherish his memory.

display.name: 警戒之灵
display.description: 如果可以的话，我真想告诉他我爱他，并会珍藏他留给我的回忆。

original.name: Eternal Triumph
original.description: Every foe felled ensures that my son's death was not in vain.

display.name: 永恒的胜利
display.description: 每击倒一个敌人，都能证明我儿子没有白白牺牲。

original.name: Vampire Hunter
original.description: Newly risen? Then you must not yet know who I am. Time for a brief introduction.

effects.description: Increases the effect of Van Richten's first set of Specializations by $(amount)%

display.name: 吸血鬼猎人
display.description: 刚刚苏醒？ 那你肯定还不知道我是谁。 是时候简单介绍一下我自己了。

effects.description: 使范·里希顿的第一套专精效果提高 $(amount)%

original.name: Vampire Slayer
original.description: You do not frighten me, monster. On the contrary, you should be afraid.

effects.description: Increases the effect of Van Richten's first set of Specializations by $(amount)%

display.name: 吸血鬼杀手
display.description: 怪物，你吓不着我。 相反，该害怕的是你。

effects.description: 使范·里希顿的第一套专精效果提高 $(amount)%

original.name: Hell's Song
original.description: My true foe has many names. 'The Devil,' for one. Well, even devils may die.

effects.description: Add Fiend as a favored foe for Van Richten.

display.name: 地狱之歌
display.description: 我真正的仇敌有很多名称。 比如说，“魔鬼”。 哼，哪怕魔鬼也是会死的。

effects.description: 将炼狱生物添加为范·里希顿的偏好对手。

original.name: Athlete
original.description: I'm no spring chicken, but I do maintain a regimen of calisthenics.

display.name: 运动员
display.description: 我已经不年轻了，但我一直在坚持做自重训练。

original.name: Inevitable Triumph
original.description: I have faith that my students will carry on my work long after I am gone.

display.name: 必然的胜利
display.description: 我相信即使在我离开很久后，我的学生们也会继续我的事业。

original.name: Mismatched Pair
original.description: The balance is off. The grip is wrong. Bah! I cannot work with this!

display.name: 不相配的一对
display.description: 平衡不行，握感也不对。 呸！ 这玩意儿我没法用！

original.name: Cane & Sword
original.description: Only a short-lived fool believes an old man incapable of defending himself.

display.name: 手杖与利剑
display.description: 只有短命的蠢货才会以为老头子没办法保护自己。

original.name: Silver Cane-Sword
original.description: An elegant weapon, for inelegant foes.

display.name: 白银杖剑
display.description: 优雅的武器，专治不优雅的敌人。

original.name: Divine Judgement
original.description: The worst monsters deserve the most agonizing ends. I insist.

display.name: 神圣裁决
display.description: 最邪恶的怪物，就该迎来最痛苦的结局。 我坚持这一点。

original.name: Disguised Hat
original.description: Where did I leave that blasted thing? And in what form? Hm...

display.name: 乔装帽
display.description: 我把那该死的玩意儿放哪儿了？ 它是什么形态来着？ 唔……

original.name: Hat of Disguise
original.description: You may have met me once or twice, but not as I appear before you now.

display.name: 伪装帽
display.description: 你也许见过我一两次，但绝不是我现在这副模样。

original.name: Ring of Mind Shielding
original.description: Let them assume they have power over me. Let them assume they are safe.

display.name: 心灵护盾戒指
display.description: 就让他们以为自己能拿捏我。 就让他们以为自己很安全。

original.name: Deliverance
original.description: Each quarrel carries searing radiance to burn away evil.

display.name: 救赎
display.description: 每支弩矢都带着灼热的圣光，可焚灭邪恶。

original.name: Expended Supplies
original.description: I should restock soon, and check in on the twins and Beatrice.

display.name: 耗尽了的物资
display.description: 我得尽快补给一下，顺便去看看那对双胞胎和比阿特丽斯。

original.name: Mordentshire Medley
original.description: Natural remedies for supernatural problems.

display.name: 莫登郡大杂烩
display.description: 解决超自然问题的自然疗法。

original.name: Tools of the Trade
original.description: I've studied the affliction. There is only one cure.

display.name: 谋生的工具
display.description: 我研究过这种病症。 只有一种治法。

original.name: Blessed Bandolier
original.description: Holy water and spell scrolls. No matter what awaits me, I am always prepared.

display.name: 庇佑弹药带
display.description: 圣水和法术卷轴。 不管前方有什么在等着我，我都时刻做好准备。

original.name: Tarnished Locket
original.description: Years of monster hunting have not been kind to it. I should clean this.

display.name: 失去了光泽的吊坠
display.description: 多年猎魔岁月的洗礼让它变得黯淡无光。 我得把它擦干净。

original.name: Locket of Loss
original.description: I must do all I can to prevent further tragedy. Ingrid, Erasmus, forgive me...

display.name: 失落吊坠
display.description: 我必须竭尽所能阻止更多悲剧发生。 英格丽德，伊拉斯姆斯，原谅我……

original.name: Doctor's Bag
original.description: My title was earned, I assure you. Now tell me your ailment and be quick.

display.name: 医生包
display.description: 我向你保证，我的头衔是我凭本事挣来的。 现在，快说说你哪里不舒服。

original.name: Guiding Light
original.description: It glows ever more brightly when sorrow shrouds my heart.

display.name: 引导之光
display.description: 当悲伤笼罩我心时，它会愈发明亮地发光。

original.name: Runaway Monkey
original.description: This one comes and goes as it pleases. Where are you off to this time?

effects.description: Increases the effect of Van Richten's first set of Specializations by $(amount)%

display.name: 逃跑的猴子
display.description: 这家伙想来就来，想走就走。 这次你又要跑哪儿去？

effects.description: 使范·里希顿的第一套专精效果提高 $(amount)%

original.name: Piccolo
original.description: This mischievous scamp delights the children. Innkeepers, less so.

effects.description: Increases the effect of Van Richten's first set of Specializations by $(amount)%

display.name: 皮科洛
display.description: 这小捣蛋鬼把孩子们逗得很开心。 不过，旅店老板可不怎么开心。

effects.description: 使范·里希顿的第一套专精效果提高 $(amount)%

original.name: Drusilla
original.description: Despite what you may have heard, her diet of apples does not deter me.

effects.description: Increases the effect of Van Richten's first set of Specializations by $(amount)%

display.name: 德鲁西拉
display.description: 不管你听说过什么，她天天吃苹果可赶不走我。

effects.description: 使范·里希顿的第一套专精效果提高 $(amount)%

original.name: Tyger
original.description: This one is well-trained. Harmless to the living. A ruinous force to the dead.

effects.description: Increases the effect of Van Richten's first set of Specializations by $(amount)%

display.name: 泰格
display.description: 这家伙训练有素。 对活人无害。 对亡者却能造成毁灭性的打击。

effects.description: 使范·里希顿的第一套专精效果提高 $(amount)%

original.name: Van Richten's Guide to Ghosts
original.description: I present cold and bare facts to arm my readers. Unlike a certain hack.

display.name: 范·里希顿的幽灵指南
display.description: 我会呈现冰冷且赤裸裸的事实，让我的读者有所准备。 不像某个三流写手。

original.name: Van Richten's Guide to Werebeasts
original.description: Not all lycanthropes are evil, mind you. However, all are dangerous.

display.name: 范·里希顿的兽人指南
display.description: 注意，并非所有兽化人都是邪恶的。 但它们全都很危险。

original.name: Van Richten's Guide to Vampires
original.description: I taught Ezmerelda - Pardon me. I taught Ez everything I know.

display.name: 范·里希顿的吸血鬼指南
display.description: 我向艾丝美拉达——抱歉， 我向艾茨传授了我所知道的一切。

original.name: Van Richten's Guide to Ravenloft
original.description: I am the foremost expert on the subject matter. It is not a boast. It is fact.

display.name: 范·里希顿的鸦阁魔域指南
display.description: 在这方面，我就是最权威的专家。 这可不是我自夸。 这是事实。
